recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add a Procedure laterality element or restore the removed extension comment for this STU3 issue; any broader bodySite/bodyStructure guidance changes should proceed under newer active Jira items.
issue_request: FHIR-15682 was a Published Patient Care change request raised against STU3 Procedure asking to add an attribute for body-site laterality to support non-SNOMED CT or pre-coordinated SNOMED CT body-site codes. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution declined a new Procedure laterality element and directed implementers to procedure-targetBodyStructure/BodyStructure.locationQualifier, with an added Procedure.bodySite comment for cases needing BodySite attributes.
initial_application: Git commit 722ed5c93f4bc9828e96f0f5b476bedc3486fb92, whose subject includes GF#15682, added the requested Procedure.bodySite comment to the historical spreadsheet source linking to procedure-targetbodystructure.
additional_context: Current source is XML-based, BodySite has been renamed/reworked as BodyStructure, and FHIR-39288 later added Procedure.bodyStructure 0..1 Reference(BodyStructure), added the mutual-exclusion rule with Procedure.bodySite, and explicitly removed the old extension comment. FHIR-51792 later restored Procedure.bodyStructure cardinality to 0..1 after FHIR-41690 considered 0..*. The procedure-targetBodyStructure extension remains in the FHIR Extension Pack for applicable contexts.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current in-build Procedure source already has Procedure.bodySite CodeableConcept and Procedure.bodyStructure Reference(BodyStructure), and BodyStructure includes includedStructure.laterality. Re-adding the FHIR-15682 extension comment would contradict the later FHIR-39288 applied resolution.

related_jiras.note: Added Procedure.bodyStructure Reference(BodyStructure), added the bodySite/bodyStructure exclusion rule, and removed the old extension comment.
Restored Procedure.bodyStructure cardinality to 0..1 for R6.
Records the rejected/reverted proposal to make Procedure.bodyStructure 0..*.
